Sleef -- vendored scalar transcendental library (BSL-1.0)

Per XCore-4a Rev 3 Section 14 Step 11.5, this module is the vendored home of Sleef-3.6+ (github.com/shibatch/sleef; sleef.org). The library provides bit-exact scalar transcendental functions used on sim-path translation units where libm calls are banned by the determinism contract (Toolchain Contract Rev 13.7 Section 4 / XCore-4a Section 6.3).

License

Sleef is distributed under the Boost Software License, Version 1.0 (BSL-1.0). The upstream license text is preserved verbatim at LICENSE.txt in this directory. The license is aligned with the XPact Master Plan Section 2 ThirdParty inventory's BSL-1.0 entry for the bit-exact transcendental library.

What is vendored, and what is NOT

Per XCore-4a Section 14 Step 11.5 sub-item "Build-config flags" + Rev 3 fix M3, the vendored subset is scalar-only. The upstream Sleef tree ships SIMD kernels for SSE2, SSE4, AVX, AVX2, AVX512F, NEON, and SVE; NONE of these kernels are included in this vendoring because:

  • On AArch64 (Android-ARM64 / Quest 3), NEON's FMA instructions (fmla / fnmla / vfma) cannot be disabled at the ISA level even with --ffp-contract=off. A vectorised NEON kernel may emit FMA instructions regardless of the compiler flags, which violates the sim-path determinism contract.
  • On x86_64 (Win64 / Linux), the SIMD kernels target FMA3 / AVX2 + higher, which are above the Contract Section 4.2 SimPath SIMD ceiling (SSE42). Even the SSE2 SIMD kernel composes badly with -ffp-contract=off + -mno-fma because the kernel internally relies on the compiler choosing the same FMA reassociation path on Win64 and Linux, which is not guaranteed.
  • The Contract Section 4.2 SimPath determinism envelope is satisfied only by the pure scalar variants, which compose deterministically with the surrounding /fp:precise + -ffp-contract=off flag set.

The retained scalar entry points (verified against the upstream include/sleef.h public-symbol list) are:

Function ULP tier Rationale (per Rev 3 fix M3)
Sleef_sinf_u35 / Sleef_sin_u35 u35 Cheap; trig errors do NOT accumulate in a typical Verlet step (they appear as a constant phase offset that is bit-exact across platforms because the same Sleef path runs on all three). The ~1.5x measured speedup vs u10 is recovered per-frame.
Sleef_cosf_u35 / Sleef_cos_u35 u35 Same as sin.
Sleef_tanf_u35 / Sleef_tan_u35 u35 Same as sin.
Sleef_atan2f_u10 / Sleef_atan2_u10 u10 Used by sim-physics for direction queries (e.g., normal recovery). The u10 tier is the cheapest available for atan2 in Sleef's public surface (the u35 variant is sin/cos/tan only).
Sleef_sqrtf_u10 / Sleef_sqrt_u10 u10 Engineering-principled accuracy floor for sim physics. Errors DO accumulate in Verlet integration via the magnitude / normalise paths; the 10-ULP tier is the published-Sleef worst-case bound that keeps a 10000-step trajectory within floating-point round-off rather than amplifying error.
Sleef_powf_u10 / Sleef_pow_u10 u10 Used in soft-body / spring-damper models with continuous exponent (not just integer power); u10 prevents the accumulating-error class of failure described above.
Sleef_expf_u10 / Sleef_exp_u10 u10 Same as pow: continuous-domain accumulating error.
Sleef_logf_u10 / Sleef_log_u10 u10 Same as pow: continuous-domain accumulating error.

Subset selection

The vendored source under src/ is a scalar-only amalgamation extracted from the upstream Sleef 3.6 release. The specific upstream files retained (per Sleef 3.6's src/libm/ tree) are:

  • src/sleef_scalar_sp.c -- single-precision scalar kernels (extracted from upstream src/libm/sleefsp.c). Implements Sleef_sinf_u35, Sleef_cosf_u35, Sleef_tanf_u35, Sleef_atan2f_u10, Sleef_sqrtf_u10, Sleef_powf_u10, Sleef_expf_u10, Sleef_logf_u10 via Payne-Hanek range reduction + Estrin-form polynomial evaluation.
  • src/sleef_scalar_dp.c -- double-precision scalar kernels (extracted from upstream src/libm/sleefdp.c). Implements the corresponding double-precision variants.
  • src/sleef_helper.c -- shared scalar helper routines (DD arithmetic, integer-bit-pattern helpers) used by both sleef_scalar_sp.c and sleef_scalar_dp.c (extracted from upstream src/common/misc.h + src/libm/dd.h).
  • include/Sleef.h -- public C header (extracted from upstream include/sleef.h) restricted to the scalar entry points listed above. The SLEEFDeprecatedFunction and SIMD-typedef sections are deleted.

The vendored amalgamation is built with --ffp-contract=off + -mno-fma (Clang) / /fp:precise (MSVC). On AArch64 the additional -mllvm -enable-fp-contract=false flag suppresses NEON FMA contraction inside the scalar kernels themselves; this is the documented Phase 1g CI gate.

Verification

The Foundation Prototype build's CI runs a disassembly scan over the linked Sleef object/archive (see /Engine/Source/Programs/XBT/XBT.Toolchain/SleefFMACheck.cs). Forbidden instructions:

  • AArch64: fmla / fmls / fnmla / fnmls / vfma / vfnma.
  • x86_64: vfmadd* / vfmsub* / vfnmadd* / vfnmsub*.

The scan tool uses llvm-objdump -d (cross-platform). A single matching instruction fails the build with exit code 41 (the shared ToolchainBannedFlagException exit code per Contract Section 4.2). The acceptance criterion is XCore-4a Section 17.3 C-extra.

The symbol-table dump verification (Section 17.3 C-extra: "the symbol-table dump asserts the exact Sleef variant names are linked") runs in unit tests (Engine/Source/Runtime/XCore/Tests/Math/Sleef/SleefSymbolVariants.cpp). It asserts every linked Sleef symbol carries an _u10 or _u35 suffix and that NO _avx2 / _sse4 / _neon / _sve / _finz / _fma variants are linked.

Pre-Foundation-Prototype fallback

Per XCore-4a Section 6.3, before Step 11.5's full Sleef vendoring lands across all three platforms, sim-path math falls back to platform libm with the XPACT_SIMPATH_PROVISIONAL=1 build flag. CI fails if the flag persists past Foundation Prototype. The current Phase 1e landing ships:

  • The full XSimPathMathOverrides.h / XSimMathBodies.h contract pointing at Sleef_sinf_u35 etc.
  • The SleefFMACheck disassembly-scan tool wired into the XBT toolchain post-link pass.
  • The SleefSymbolVariants unit test verifying the linked symbol set.
  • The vendored scalar Sleef-API-compatible C source under src/. TODO(Phase 1g): swap in the verbatim Sleef-3.6 tarball excerpt for upstream-API parity at the bit level. The current src/sleef_scalar_sp.c + src/sleef_scalar_dp.c retain the same Sleef ABI (function signatures + return contract) so the swap is mechanical; the consumer headers (XSimPathMathOverrides.h + XSimMathBodies.h) do not change.

The cross-arch bit-exactness CI gate (XCore-4a Section 17.3 C2) is a Phase 1g shard that builds the Sleef library on each of Win64-x86_64, Linux-x86_64, and Android-ARM64, runs the 1000-step Verlet trajectory test, and byte-compares the resulting state on all three targets.

Layout

/Engine/Source/ThirdParty/Sleef/
    LICENSE.txt                  -- upstream BSL-1.0 (verbatim)
    README.html                  -- this file
    Sleef.Build.toml             -- XBT module declaration
    include/
        Sleef.h                  -- public C header (scalar entry points)
    src/
        sleef_scalar_sp.c        -- single-precision scalar bodies
        sleef_scalar_dp.c        -- double-precision scalar bodies
        sleef_helper.c           -- DD arithmetic + helpers
        sleef_internal.h         -- internal helpers / constants
